title: The Wyrm
subtitle: Small nodes, a wide open canvas
description: Nothing in this chapter lines up, and that is the lesson. A spine bends
twice across the canvas, two short branches hang off it, and a moon sits
above the middle -- all of it placed by hand, none of it on a grid.
It is also the smallest a node gets. Sixteen pixels is the floor, and an
icon that fills it is what makes a speck read as a star rather than as a
dot; the moon is the other end of both ranges at once.
The dependencies are ordinary ones -- each star names the last sighting it
needs -- so the figure can be walked in order, or wandered into from either
